Truenorth Inc decreased its stake in Illumina Inc (ILMN) by 11.98% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Truenorth Inc sold 1,728 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 12,702 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.00M, down from 14,430 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Truenorth Inc who had been investing in Illumina Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $42.07B market cap company. The stock increased 0.15% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $286.18. About 250,541 shares traded. Illumina, Inc. (NASDAQ:ILMN) has risen 53.21% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 40.64% the S&P500.
